analysis.reasonEn: RSI has risen to 38.3, exiting the oversold territory (30 level), but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram is holding steady at 0.7834 without improvement. ADX is at 22.1, indicating an early stage of trend formation with uncertain direction. A potential Higher Low pattern is forming as the 5-day low is above the 20-day low, but volume is subdued at 0.49x the 5-day average, reducing confidence in a trend reversal. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.
